ontology.note: Existing ontology alignment, plus the inclusion rule and outer margin now recorded as typed provenance so receipts produced under different rules cannot be mistaken for each other. fw:rasterMaskConvention is constrained by SHACL to a known identifier. EMITS IS EMPTY AND THE MODULE IS NOT. validate:widgets compares this against what it can read from core.ts#TYPES, which for this widget is nothing: the fw: terms the clip actually asserts -- RasterClipping, clipGeometry, rasterMaskMethod, rasterMaskMarginPixels, validCellCount and the rest -- are built in raster-workflow.ts, where the extraction does not look. Declared empty on 2026-10-23 to match what the check can see, with the discrepancy written here rather than papered over: the sibling raster_input carries the same empty declaration for the same reason, so this is the convention and not an oversight of this release.

changes.description: A margin past the raster's edge is cut to the raster, never filled with cells it does not hold, where it used to stop the run.

evidence.note: Independently compared against rasterio 1.5.2 with GDAL 3.12.2 over a synthetic CRS84 grid and a concave, pixel-aligned cutline: cell centre inside agrees exactly; all touched differs by 2 of 146 cells, both GDAL-only and attributable to its line rasterizer. A unit test pins the convention at an exactly aligned border. The margin has no GDAL equivalent and is compared only against a dilation model, so it remains unvalidated. No claim is made about cartographic or scientific suitability. 1.1.1: tests/raster.test.mjs.
